identificationModule.briefTitle: Neo ALTTO (Neoadjuvant Lapatinib and/or Trastuzumab Treatment Optimisation) Study
identificationModule.officialTitle: Neo ALTTO (Neoadjuvant Lapatinib and/or Trastuzumab Treatment Optimisation) Study: A Randomised, Multicenter Open-label Phase III Study of Neoadjuvant Lapatinib, Trastuzumab and Their Combination Plus Paclitaxel in Women With HER2/ErbB2 Positive Primary Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm 1 Lapatinib
armGroups.description: 1500 mg lapatinib for 6 weeks followed by lapatinib plus weekly paclitaxel for an additional 12 weeks. After definitive surgery, 3 cycles of adjuvant FEC followed by 34 weeks of adjuvant lapatinib.

armGroups.label: Arm 2 Trastuzumab
armGroups.description: 4 mg/kg IV loading dose followed by 2 mg/kg IV weekly trastuzumab for 6 weeks followed by 2 mg/kg trastuzumab plus weekly paclitaxel for an additional 12 weeks. After definitive surgery, 3 cycles of adjuvant FEC followed by 34 weeks of adjuvant trastuzumab (8 mg/kg loading dose followed by 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks).

armGroups.label: Arm 3 Lapatinib plus Trastuzumab
armGroups.description: 1000 mg lapatinib plus 4 mg/kg IV loading dose followed by 2 mg/kg IV weekly trastuzumab for 6 weeks, followed by 750 mg lapatinib plus 2 mg/kg IV weekly trastuzumab plus weekly paclitaxel for an additional 12 weeks. After definitive surgery, 3 cycles of adjuvant FEC followed by 34 weeks of adjuvant lapatinib (1000 mg) in combination with trastuzumab (8 mg/kg loading dose followed by 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks).

interventions.name: Lapatinib
interventions.description: Small molecule receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor
